pr_body:
`X509Certificate` methods `getSubjectDN` and `getIssuerDN` are deprecated.
Use `getSubjectX500Principal` and `getIssuerX500Principal` instead.

Closes #81008
pr_comments: Hi @n1v0lg, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Not sure if `>upgrade`is a more appropriate label for this one. Assuming this one is good to have in release notes.

issue_context.title: Remove deprecated usages of X509Certificate.getSubjectDN()
issue_context.body:
`X509Certificate#getSubjectDN` has been deprecated starting with Java 16. This gets used in a number of places in our security code and is recommended that usages be replaced with `getSubjectX500Principal`.

https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/2ivni47qk473q
comments: Thanks Mark, we did discuss this back on March 18 and I could swear we're tracking this with an issue but apparently we didn't * until now!).

review_comments: Hmm actually this one might be another breaking change; validating it
Under the hood, both getSubjectX500Principal().toString() and getSubjectDN().toString() rely on X500Name.toString() so this should be fine
The method is only used for logging messages which we don't provide any BWC.
